aboutUs.headline: Leading M&E Engineering Company with Decades of Excellence
aboutUs.background:
IT Usaha Engineering Sdn Bhd is a leading engineering firm in Malaysia, specializing in Data Centre infrastructure and mission-critical electrical systems. With decades of industry experience and a proven track record of delivering more than 30 Data Centres nationwide, we support some of the most demanding clients in the digital ecosystem.

  Our services cover the full project lifecycle, from initial design and engineering to construction, testing, and facilities management. Backed by a highly skilled team of engineers, project managers, and technical staff, we offer expertise in mechanical and electrical (M&E) works, HT and LV systems, BMS, Security System, ELV installations, BIM modeling, CFD simulation, and ETAP – Energy Management Solution Software. Known for our strong safety performance, strong financial footing, and strategic partnerships with global technology providers, we deliver infrastructure that meets international standards for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
aboutUs.vision: To be the No.1 MEP engineering solutions provider, recognized for our commitment to quality, sustainability, and client satisfaction in the Data Centre industry
aboutUs.mission: To design and implement cutting-edge MEP solutions that power the seamless operation of critical data centre environments by optimizing energy efficiency, uncompromising reliability, and long-term sustainability.
aboutUs.leadershipIntro: Meet the driving forces behind IT Usaha that made us what we are today, and continue to lead the team towards higher standards and performance.

leaders.name: Jeffrey Low Wei Keong
leaders.bio: Since 1997, our Chairman and Founder has been the driving force behind IT Usaha Engineering’s growth. Under his esteemed leadership, the company has successfully executed projects exceeding RM200 million in contract value across diverse development sectors — a testament to his vision, discipline, and unwavering commitment to engineering excellence.

leaders.name: Leong Choon Keong
leaders.bio: Our Managing Director has extensive experience in project planning, design, and management since 1998. Under his leadership, the company has delivered projects exceeding RM1 billion. We are committed to providing reliable, high-quality engineering and technology solutions with integrity, innovation, and excellence.

leaders.name: Ng Kim Han
leaders.bio: Since 2001, our Executive Director has overseen the overall management and development of IT Usaha, ensuring smooth operations and effective coordination across all departments. He is instrumental in building strong teams, streamlining processes, and maintaining high standards of performance. His commitment to quality and structured management practices supports the company’s alignment with ISO 9001:2015 standards.

aboutUs.milestonesIntro: Since 1997, every project and achievement has marked a step forward in our journey. Discover the key milestones that highlight our evolution from a local electrical contractor to a leading M&E solutions provider for mission-critical infrastructure.

milestones.body: IT Usaha Engineering was founded, specializing in M&E services.
Completed our 1st Data Centre Construction for Telekom Malaysia, KL.
Completed electrical services for Marina BS Tower 3, Singapore.
Completed Full Turnkey Data Centre construction for TIME DOT COM, Kuantan.
Completed Full Turnkey Cable Landing Station for TIME DOT COM, Pulau Pinang.
Supplied, installed, and commissioned Electrical Services at Four Seasons Place, Kuala Lumpur.
Completed Electrical LV works at AIMS Menara KL Data Centre Construction (IT Load Capacity: 5 MW).
Completed Cable Landing Station Infra Upgrade Project at Cherating, Kuantan.
Supplied and installed Electrical LV System for AIMS Cyberjaya Blk 1 (IT Load Capacity: 6 MW).
Completed M&E Fit-Out for Iskandar Puteri Data Centre (IPDC) (IT Load Capacity: 2.5 MW).
Critical Equipment Testing & Commissioning for AIR TRUNK JHB1, Johor Bahru.
Full Mechanical & Electrical System works for AIMS Cyberjaya Blk 1, 2 & 3 (IT Load Capacity: 24 MW).
Full Mechanical and Electrical system works for TM Nxera, Block 1 (IT Load Capacity: 16 MW).
Expanding Data Centre, Cable Landing Station, and Critical Infrastructure services with future-ready designs.

serviceDataCentre.heading: Data Centre & Critical System
serviceDataCentre.intro: Since 1997, ITU has completed many Data Centre projects nationwide, we don’t just build data centres but we run them. With decades of industry experience and more than 100 completed projects nationwide, we are both a trusted MEP and data centre contractor, supporting some of Malaysia’s most demanding digital workloads.

turnkey.title: Turnkey Design, Build & Operate Services
turnkey.body: We handle the entire lifecycle of the infrastructure from design and construction to live operations. Our in-house experts oversee CSA (Civil, Structural, & Architectural), MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing), testing, commissioning, and certification to meet global standards such as the Uptime Institute.
turnkey.subtitle: Computational Fluid Dynamics Simulation
turnkey.subBody: We have our own CFD project tool that simulates the behavior of fluids and their thermodynamic properties using numerical models. Engineers use the Cadence Fidelity CFD Platform for design processes, such as propulsion, aerodynamics, hydrodynamics, and combustion, to improve and increase the efficiency of products by reducing time-consuming and expensive physical testing.

critical.title: Critical Infrastructure Expertise
critical.body: We design and deliver essential systems that ensure performance and safety:

items.text: Electrical System and UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply)
BMS, Access Control, ELV and Security System

testing.title: DC Testing & Commissioning Services
testing.body: Don’t leave the performance of your DC systems to chance. We provide essential testing and commissioning services for high-voltage equipment, battery banks, and control systems. Using state-of-the-art tools and a meticulous process, we ensure every component is tested for peak performance, safety, and compliance. Our service guarantees a seamless and reliable launch for your electrical infrastructure, protecting your investment and preventing future downtime.

why.title: Live Data Centre Operations
why.body: Our facilities host high-availability environments for major enterprises. With dedicated teams on-site 24/7/365, we provide round-the-clock support, preventive maintenance, and fast-response solutions to ensure zero downtime.

why.title: Scalable, Future-Proof Design
why.body: Using Revit BIM (Building Information Modeling) and CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) simulation tools, we design modular spaces that allow seamless scaling. Expansion and upgrades can be done with minimal impact on operations.

seo.title: Data Centre & Critical System
seo.description: Turnkey data centre design, build, operate, and testing & commissioning services by IT Usaha Engineering.

serviceHighTension.heading: High Tension & Low Voltage Electric Power and High Tension Switchgear & Transformer
serviceHighTension.intro: We deliver safe, reliable, and code-compliant high tension (HT) and low voltage (LV) electrical systems to support commercial, industrial, and data centre operations. From substation setup to transformer and switchgear installation, our team ensures consistent, stable power distribution for even the most demanding facilities.

power.title: High Tension (HT) Power Systems
power.body: We design and install high tension systems (typically 11 kV and above) that deliver electricity from the grid to your facility through substations and switchgear setups.

items.text: Compliance with energy authority regulations (e.g., Suruhanjaya Tenaga)

power.title: Switchgear & Transformer Solutions
power.body: We supply, install, and test both HT and LV switchgear along with transformers that step voltage levels up or down as needed for operational safety and energy efficiency.

power.title: MV & LV Distribution
power.body: From the transformer output, we implement LV systems (415V and below) for safe and efficient internal power distribution.

items.text: Integration with control panels and backup systems

divider1.heading: Electrical Works, Generator Sets & Motor Installation
divider1.body: From robust electrical installations to reliable backup power systems, our electrical engineering team delivers high-performance solutions for mission-critical environments. With decades of hands-on experience, we ensure every component from power cabling to motor control is built for efficiency, safety, and long-term durability.

backup.title: Generator Sets (Genset)
backup.body: To guarantee power continuity, we supply and install diesel generator systems designed for instant switchovers during power failures. Integrated ATS (Automatic Transfer Switches) allow seamless transition between grid and backup power.

items.text: Fuel tank and exhaust system setup

backup.title: ACMV Installation Services
backup.body: Our team handles the installation of industrial motors for various operational functions from HVAC systems to water pumps and specialized machinery.

items.text: Soft starters and VFDs (Variable Frequency Drives)

divider2.heading: Lighting Electrical Services and Lightning Protection
divider2.body: At IT Usaha, we provide BMS, fire and lightning protection solutions, designed to enhance safety, efficiency, and reliability for both commercial and industrial spaces. With years of expertise, we specialize in designing, installing, and maintaining top-tier lighting and lightning protection systems to meet your building’s needs.

protection.title: BMS and Security System
protection.body: At IT Usaha, we specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of low-voltage (ELV) systems that ensure effective communication, entertainment, and operational efficiency across various industries. Our ELV solutions include public address (PA) systems, MATV (Master Antenna Television) setups, and PABX (Private Automatic Branch Exchange) systems, each tailored to meet the unique needs of your environment.

protection.title: Fire Protection System
protection.body: A Fire Protection System is a comprehensive network of equipment and strategies designed to detect, control, and extinguish fires to protect life, property, and the environment. These systems are essential for minimizing the impact of fire-related incidents in residential, commercial, and industrial settings.

protection.title: Lightning Protection
protection.body: Protecting your building from lightning strikes is essential to avoid costly damages and ensure the safety of the people within. We use the latest technology and industry best practices to safeguard your structure from electrical surges and lightning strikes, ensuring maximum protection for your building’s infrastructure.
protection.note: Our lightning protection systems are designed with reliability and compliance to international standards, including:

feature.title: Safety. Reliability. Compliance.
feature.body: All installations are completed in line with Malaysian Electrical Codes and international standards, ensuring operational reliability, safety, and audit readiness.

serviceFacilitiesManagement.heading: Facilities Management Services
serviceFacilitiesManagement.intro: We don’t just build data centres — we stay with them for the long run. IT Usaha offers 24/7/365 Facilities Management (FM) services tailored exclusively for mission-critical data centre environments. Our expert team ensures continuous uptime, operational efficiency, and long-term reliability all while aligning with international standards.

support.title: 24/7/365 Support & Maintenance
support.body: Our dedicated FM teams provide round-the-clock monitoring, rapid response, and preventive maintenance to ensure uninterrupted operations.

items.text: Health checks, performance tuning & system optimization

maintenance.title: Critical System Maintenance Expertise
maintenance.body: We maintain all core infrastructure that keeps your data centre running securely and efficiently:

items.text: Precision cooling and liquid cooling systems

why.title: Zero Downtime Commitment
why.body: Our proactive FM approach minimizes risks and ensures high availability ideal for enterprises that depend on 24/7 digital infrastructure.

why.title: Operated by Data Centre Experts
why.body: With decades of experience as both a builder and operator, we understand the intricacies of mission-critical environments better than anyone else.
